=== SERVICE DETAILS ===
Heading: Foundation Problems Don’t Fix Themselves
Intro: Small warning signs can turn into expensive structural issues if they’re ignored.
Checklist:
- Cracks in walls or brick
- Uneven or sloping floors
- Doors and windows sticking
- Gaps around trim or cabinets
- Water pooling near foundation
- Bowing or settling foundation
